motive.zhHans: 由于图书馆里有毒书，他可以把它伪装成意外死亡。他后来被 Nojima 发现，并因此被当作奴隶般使唤。Michiko 解释说她在医院无事可做，于是写完了小说并自费出版。柯南一笑置之，因为他意识到自己的期望太高了。
motive.en: Since there are poisonous books in the library, he could make it look like an accidental death. He was later found out by Nojima, and he was made to work like a slave because of that. Michiko explains that she finished her novel since she had nothing to do at the hospital and self-published it. Conan laughs it off since he realizes his hopes were too high.

Since there are poisonous books in the library, he could make it look like an accidental death.

resolution.zhHans: 犯人是 Kosuke Omura。原本的目标是 Ryoji Nojima，但 Michiko 无意中落入了他的陷阱。Michiko 舔了受伤的手指，从而吞下了毒药。死因是书内涂了毒的美工刀刀片，而不是书封。Kosuke 原本计划在 Ryoji 从书架上拿起放错位置的书割到手指时对他下毒。由于图书馆里有毒书，他可以把它伪装成意外死亡。Omura 承认他在身无分文时偷了 Nojima 的书并卖掉。他后来被 Nojima 发现，并因此被当作奴隶般使唤。由于忍无可忍，他决定杀害 Ryoji Nojima。
resolution.en: The culprit is Kosuke Omura. The intended victim was Ryoji Nojima, but Michiko unknowingly fell into his trap. Michiko licked her wounded finger which made her swallow the poison. The cause was a poisoned box cutter blade inside the book, not the book cover. Kosuke originally planned to poison Ryoji when he cut his finger while picking up the wrongly-placed book from the shelf. Since there are poisonous books in the library, he could make it look like an accidental death. Omura admits that he when he was broke, he stole and sold Nojima's book. He was later found out by Nojima, and he was made to work like a slave because of that. Due to having reached his limit, he decided to murder Ryoji Nojima.

summary.en: Michiko Yoshikawa invites the Detective Boys to Kosuke Omura's writing class, as she wants to learn how to write a novel. The class is held at Ryoji Nojima's house, who sponsored Omura for his books. When Nojima reads how the children write a story, he decides to take them to the basement, where he keeps many valuable books. He asks the group to start reading the book he handled for references.

suspects: Ryoji Nojima, Kosuke Omura, and Nagisa Takeuchi
